{"arguments": {"content": "import math
import sys
from datetime import timedelta

import openpyxl

def main():
    in_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(in_path)
    ws = wb["Sheet1"]

    # Round time values in column B (formatted as [h]:mm) up to the nearest
    # whole hour, writing the result into column C (range C1:C2) with General
    # number format.
    for row in range(1, 3):
        b = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value
        if isinstance(b, timedelta):
            total_hours = b.total_seconds() / 3600.0
            ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value = math.ceil(total_hours)
        ws.cell(row=row, column=3).number_format = "General"

    wb.save(out_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()", "path": "/bench/answers/38462/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
